WMR resolved as CONDITIONAL/THEOREM (H1–H3). Numerical updates: ε_w = 0.012301. Wolfram adversarial review incorporated. F_abs vs L_1/L_2 distinction sharpened throughout. Full Appendix A catalog inherited from Paper 21 (Steps 1–207) with Paper 22 results appended (Steps 208–256). Spatial Hodge complex and TT extension established. Channel Floor Theorem derived. Energy decay profiles and no-go landscape (Part IV). Rate-dressing paradigm, zero-parameter amplitude construction, conditional bridge operator, and comprehensive premise derivation history (Part V). TT1 derived (Round 20). Final premise package: GMP + WMR + TBS.

Beginning from two premises — (1) the observable universe exists inside a Schwarzschild black hole, and (2) the physics inside the horizon is the same as outside — Paper 21 identified the Spatial Hodge Complex as the prerequisite infrastructure for the radiation response problem, perturbation theory, and the reduced → full algebra extension. This paper constructs that infrastructure.

The paradigm shift: the no-go landscape proves that F_abs = 0.36879 cannot enter the expansion rate as energy density. The surviving mechanism is rate dressing — the puncture algebra modifies bulk interaction cross-sections through the spatial channel infrastructure. The j=1 vector channel dresses weak interaction rates at freeze-out; the j=2 tensor channel dresses nuclear phase space at the deuterium bottleneck. Conditional on GMP and TBS (WMR resolved in v1.1), the zero-parameter amplitude construction (Theorem 22.23) builds the rate dressings from the singleton puncture loads L_1 = 0.2242 (j=1) and L_2 = 0.1381 (j=2) combined with established framework constants K_gauge and ⟨K⟩/10. The construction does not use F_abs directly; whether the singleton loads connect to F_abs through a channel-resolved decomposition remains open. The BBN scorecard gives χ²(D/H + Y_p) = 1.50, substantially lower than the two-parameter fitted comparator (3.07) in the current PRyMordial setup, though no nuisance marginalization has been performed. Li-7 internal consistency with the uniform-ΔN_eff benchmark is confirmed out of sample (Theorem 22.24), though Li-7 itself remains at +12.29σ from observation.

The formal bridge operator (Theorem 22.25) is constructed conditional on the Geometric Mediation Principle (GMP, proposed as a new framework premise) plus TBS; WMR resolved in v1.1, TT1 derived. GMP states that boundary puncture data mediate to matter observables through induced spatial geometric carriers, not through direct Standard Model gauge identification.

The Spatial Hodge Complex is closed for the scalar/vector/tensor channel infrastructure. The Hodge complex, TT extension, Peter-Weyl bridge, and Channel Floor Theorem provide the mathematical infrastructure for the reduced → full algebra extension, the perturbation theory program, and the P_resp construction.
Full-Radiation Scaling Equivalence (Theorem 22.14): ρ_r → (1+F_abs)ρ_r gives ΔN_eff,eq = 2.746, not F_abs. Catastrophic failure. DERIVED.

Zero-Parameter Amplitude Construction (Theorem 22.23): ε_w = K_gauge × L_1, ε_n = (⟨K⟩/10) × L_2. χ² = 1.50 with zero fitted parameters, conditional on GMP + TBS (WMR resolved in v1.1). Uses singleton loads L_1, L_2, not F_abs. DERIVED.

Li-7 Out-of-Sample Consistency (Theorem 22.24): internal consistency with uniform-ΔN_eff benchmark to 0.07% fractionally; Li-7 not used in calibration. Li-7 itself remains at +12.29σ from observation. DERIVED.
Geometric Mediation Principle (GMP): new framework premise. NEW PREMISE.

The coexact vector sector contains no J = 0 component. This is the puncture-to-spatial channel bridge: different diagonal SU(2) spins J in the puncture fixed-point algebra B(H_A)^{SU(2)} = ⊕J (I{V_J} ⊗ B(M_A^J)) couple to different spatial Hodge channels through the Peter-Weyl structure.

The Absolute Local Casimir Load F_abs = 0.36879 from Paper 21 includes contributions from all j ≥ 1/2 through the bounded resolvent kernel C₂/(4+C₂). Whether F_abs admits a clean vector/tensor channel decomposition is an open question that depends on the (unresolved) delivery kernels.

Paper 21 Theorem 21.G proves βE_j = 2πγ√(j(j+1)) is temperature-independent. The puncture Gibbs weights w_j = (2j+1)exp(−βE_j) are geometric constants. Therefore Z_punc, the P_J projectors, and the current boundary load data (including the F_abs construction) do not themselves provide epoch dependence. No boundary-side quantity switches off between BBN and recombination.
Note: F_abs permanence uses the fixed-point algebra / Casimir construction (Paper 21) in addition to Theorem 21.G; it is not a corollary of 21.G alone.
Z_punc, F_abs, or the P_J projectors (Theorem 22.9: permanent)
The spatial Hodge/TT projectors alone (Theorem 22.8: stress scalarization)

Consequence: if Δ(BBN) = F_abs to match the D/H target, then Δ(recomb) ≥ F_abs. A BBN-calibrated radiation-like load injected from the boundary cannot be smaller at recombination. The entire class of positive-injection fluid models is killed.

Parts III–IV established the channel infrastructure and proved that every model treating F_abs as injected energy density fails: stress scalarization feeds all channels into H(z) (Theorem 22.8), the injection ratio is monotone (Theorem 22.13), and uniform radiation multipliers produce catastrophic ΔN_eff (Round 6). Nine independent no-gos eliminate fluid injection, uniform dressing, separable coupling, connection-power gates, bounded-ratio saturators, and persistent radiation.

The pattern is systematic: every dead route promotes F_abs into a homogeneous background scalar. The no-gos kill it immediately. This forces a category shift: the boundary-to-bulk coupling does not add energy density to the Friedmann constraint. The surviving mechanism is rate dressing — the puncture algebra modifies interaction cross-sections during BBN without modifying the expansion rate H(z). The operative quantities are the singleton puncture loads L_1 (j=1) and L_2 (j=2), not F_abs directly. The relationship between F_abs (the full-spectrum bounded Casimir response) and the singleton loads (the individual j=1 and j=2 energy-weighted contributions) remains an open question.
If ρ_r → (1+F_abs)ρ_r, then the equivalent effective neutrino count is:
ΔN_eff,eq = [(1 + β_rel N_eff,base)/β_rel] × F_abs = 2.746

where β_rel = (7/8)(4/11)^{4/3}. This is NOT equivalent to ΔN_eff = F_abs. The uniform radiation multiplier catastrophically fails both BBN (D/H = +25.6σ, Y_p = +8.3σ) and the acoustic scale (θ* shift −10%).

No single scalar c_rad applied as ρ_r → (1+c_rad)ρ_r closes both D/H and θ* simultaneously. The D/H-matching coefficient c_DH = 0.0495 still shifts θ* by ~1.5%. The θ*-matching coefficient c_θ = 0.0138 leaves D/H at −2.96σ. The two observables pull in opposite directions under uniform radiation dressing.

The freeze-out window is primarily a helium lever (Y_p moves more than D/H). The nucleosynthesis window is primarily a deuterium lever (D/H moves seven times more than Y_p). This is consistent with standard BBN physics: Y_p is set by weak freeze-out, D/H by the deuterium bottleneck.

The target displacement from baseline to the F_abs benchmark has slope Δ(Y_p_σ)/Δ(D/H_σ) ≈ 0.302 in the (D/H, Y_p) plane. At the framework-constant amplitudes, PRyMordial gives Li7/H = 5.391 × 10⁻¹⁰ (+12.29σ from observation), matching the uniform-ΔN_eff benchmark to 0.07% fractionally. Li-7 was not used in any calibration. The rate-dressing paradigm neither solves nor worsens the lithium problem. He-3 prediction: 3He/H = 1.051 × 10⁻⁵.
17.1 The Geometric Mediation Principle (GMP)

GMP is consistent with the existing framework (CMP, BDP, GTTP all operate through geometric carriers, not through direct gauge identification). It is independent of the other three principles. It is falsifiable: it would be contradicted by any successful framework completion requiring puncture data to couple as direct Standard Model charges rather than through spatial geometry.

(GMP) Geometric Mediation Principle: Boundary puncture data mediate through induced spatial geometric carriers. (WMR, resolved in v1.1) The weak bridge reads V(α) = K_gauge via the Quadratic Thermal Covariance Theorem, conditional on premises H1–H3: (H1) the explicit spatial KMS extension is the physical bridge state; (H2) the minimal spatial CCR lift is the physical perturbation sector; (H3) the physical weak rate is a two-point function. (TBS) The active unconstrained TT response saturates the full modular budget ⟨K⟩
with active matrix elements −0.012301 (weak channel) and −0.023842 (nuclear channel), giving the BBN scorecard above.

The sector selection follows from GMP plus the Channel Floor Theorem: gauge-current couplings are vector observables (j=1 channel), metric-dependent phase-space corrections are TT tensor observables (j=2 channel).
Status: DERIVED (conditional on GMP + TBS; WMR resolved in v1.1, TT1 derived).

The bridge operator was originally constructed conditional on four premises: GMP, WMR, TBS, and TT1. TT1 was derived (Round 20). WMR was resolved in v1.1 via the Quadratic Thermal Covariance Theorem (conditional on H1–H3). The two remaining premises are GMP and TBS:

GMP (Geometric Mediation Principle): Boundary SU(2) puncture data do not become Standard Model gauge charges. They determine spatial geometric carriers on H_spatial, and matter-sector observables are affected only through their dependence on those induced connection/metric carriers. Status: DERIVED
Premise hierarchy: GMP is upstream — TBS only becomes operative once GMP has identified the bridge as geometric-carrier mediated. These are layered assumptions, not three independent axioms.
18.1 The Spatial Hodge Complex: CLOSED

The rate-dressing paradigm opens a viable conditional route past the BBN-vs-recombination tension that blocked all previous approaches. The zero-parameter amplitude construction (Theorem 22.23) produces χ² = 1.50 on the BBN scorecard. The formal bridge operator (Theorem 22.25) is originally conditional on four premises (GMP, WMR, TBS, TT1). TT1 was derived (Round 20); WMR was resolved in v1.1. Two remain: GMP and TBS. The coefficient gaps (WMR since resolved; TBS still open) were attacked from eleven independent routes (Rounds 19–25); all produced structural advances; WMR was subsequently resolved, TBS remains open. Both gaps reflect the divide between local/perturbative and global/modular quantities. Future targets: the internal Hamiltonian constraint operator, the modular charge identification, and the equivariant bridge uniqueness theorem.
18.7 The F_abs Connection

The investigation was motivated by the numerical coincidence F_abs = 0.36879 ≈ ΔN_eff = 0.3685 (0.066% agreement). The no-go landscape killed F_abs as an energy density. The surviving mechanism operates through the singleton loads L_1 and L_2, not through F_abs directly. Whether the F_abs ≈ ΔN_eff coincidence reflects a deep channel-resolved decomposition or is a numerical accident of how PRyMordial responds to rate suppressions remains an open question.

GMP (Geometric Mediation Principle): The S³ ≅ SU(2) identification constrains the bridge to geometric carriers but does not universally forbid non-geometric maps. GMP remains a premise pending the construction of a uniqueness theorem for equivariant bridge maps.

Paper 22 establishes the Spatial Hodge Complex, derives the rate-dressing paradigm for the radiation response problem, and constructs a conditional bridge operator connecting the boundary puncture algebra to BBN interaction rates through the spatial channel infrastructure, subject to two remaining premises (GMP + TBS; WMR resolved in v1.1).

Framework-constant predictions (Theorems 22.23–22.24): Conditional on GMP and TBS (WMR resolved in v1.1), the rate dressings ε_w = K_gauge × L_1 and ε_n = (⟨K⟩/10) × L_2 use zero fitted parameters. Every constant comes from the established framework. The BBN scorecard gives χ² = 1.50 (vs 3.07 for the two-parameter fitted comparator in the current PRyMordial setup). The construction uses the singleton puncture loads L_1 and L_2, not a derived decomposition of F_abs. Li-7 internal consistency with the uniform-ΔN_eff benchmark confirmed out of sample, though Li-7 remains at +12.29σ from observation.

The bridge operator (Theorem 22.25): P_resp^(bridge) is formally constructed on A_weak ⊗̄ A_nuclear ⊗̄ H_spatial ⊗̄ B(H_A)^{SU(2)}, originally conditional on four premises: GMP, WMR, TBS, and TT1. TT1 was derived (Round 20); WMR was resolved in v1.1. GMP and TBS remain. Eleven derivation routes across Rounds 19–25 attacked the coefficient gaps: six targeted WMR (resolved in v1.1) and five targeted TBS (still open). All produced structural theorems and comprehensive no-gos.

The structural heart of the paper is a conceptual shift: the no-go landscape proves that F_abs cannot enter the expansion rate as energy density. The surviving mechanism is rate dressing: the puncture algebra modifies bulk interaction cross-sections through the spatial channel infrastructure. The j=1 vector channel dresses weak rates at freeze-out; the j=2 tensor channel dresses nuclear phase space at the deuterium bottleneck. The boundary broadcasts permanently (Theorem 22.9); the universe’s own thermodynamic evolution provides the epoch dependence. The amplitude construction (Theorem 22.23) builds the rate dressings from the singleton puncture loads L_1 and L_2, not from F_abs directly. Whether F_abs admits a clean channel-resolved decomposition into these loads remains an open question.

Paper 22 does not fully derive P_resp. The bridge operator is conditional on two remaining premises (GMP + TBS). It reduces the gap from Paper 21’s nineteen dead routes and an unspecified target to two narrow, physically motivated premises with clear future derivation targets — and zero-parameter numerical validation already in hand. The framework’s three previous principles (CMP, BDP, GTTP) were all upgraded to derived/theorem status within 6–8 papers of their introduction; GMP and TBS enter at the same developmental stage.

docx_edit_locations.heading_context: A.1.25 Paper 20 New Results: The Acoustic Projection and BBN Radiation Algebra
docx_edit_locations.text: Step 240: Geometric Mediation Principle (GMP). New framework premise: boundary SU(2) puncture data determine spatial geometric carriers on H_spatial; matter observables affected only through dependence on induced connection/metric carriers. Consistent with CMP/BDP/GTTP. Independent. Falsifiable. Narrowed form: the boundary-to-bulk map is generated by the shared SU(2) regular representation and is SU(2)-equivariant. The algebra admits non-geometric bridge maps (operators with no spatial leg), so S³ ≅ SU(2) topology alone does not force universal GMP. STATUS: DERIVED

docx_edit_locations.text: Step 253: Round 25 Frontier Statement. The bridge operator P_resp^(bridge) is originally conditional on four premises (GMP, WMR, TBS, TT1). WMR (K_gauge) is resolved via the Quadratic Thermal Covariance Theorem (conditional on H1–H3). The surviving upgrade paths are: (1) modular intertwining for TBS, (2) equivariant bridge uniqueness for GMP. STATUS: DERIVED
